candidate_sentence_map.S1: Coop Pank reported a net profit of €28.7 million for 2025, an 11% decline compared to the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The reduction was primarily attributable to a challenging interest rate environment that compressed net interest income to €73.3 million, partially offsetting strong volume expansion.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Total net operating income decreased modestly to €79.4 million, while net fee and commission income rose slightly to €4.5 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Return on equity fell to 12.9% from 16.2% in 2024, and the cost-to-income ratio increased to 52.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Despite these profitability pressures, the bank executed its growth strategy vigorously, expanding its loan portfolio by €340 million, or 19%, to €2.11 billion.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Corporate lending drove the majority of this growth at 27%, followed by a 17% increase in mortgage financing.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Customer deposits also grew steadily by 9% to €2.05 billion, supported by a 11% rise in demand deposits as the bank added 19,000 new clients to reach a total of 227,000.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The financial outcome was shaped by macroeconomic tailwinds and deliberate strategic investments.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Estonia’s economy recorded 0.7% real GDP growth in 2025 after years of contraction, while ECB policy rate cuts and falling EURIBOR rates gradually restored borrowing confidence across the market.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: To sustain expansion and optimize funding costs, Coop Pank issued €250 million in four-year covered bonds on the Irish stock exchange, securing its first tranche of international debt under a €750 million program.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Simultaneously, the bank concluded a synthetic securitization agreement with the European Investment Bank Group, transferring credit risk on a designated loan portfolio to unlock capital relief and enable up to €249 million in targeted lending for environmental and social projects.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Leadership transitions included the appointment of Arko Kurtmann as chairman of the management board, while product innovation expanded through a sector-first monthly cashback loyalty program, fully virtual card offerings, and physical branch network enhancements.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Cooperating closely with its domestic cooperative ownership, the bank maintained a strong capital buffer with a total capital adequacy ratio of 18.54% and distributed €7.2 million in dividends aligned with its historical payout policy.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Overall, the reporting period characterized a deliberate trade-off between aggressive market penetration and near-term margin compression, positioning the bank to capture improved earnings once interest rates stabilize and funded asset growth matures into recurring income streams.
